column1: ## Repository Table R13. Within-position discrimination of DDD alternative alleles

## Description: Each confirmed DDD ALT is compared with the two other nonreference nucleotides at the same position. Alternative candidates are not experimentally established benign alleles. This endpoint remains one of the 45 Fig. 5 ranking units, although not a separate main panel.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Model | Evaluated checkpoint display name, harmonized with the figures.
## Column 2 | Valid variant trios | Valid variant trios for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Observed allele ranked first | Observed allele ranked first for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Lower 95% bound | Source-reported percentile interval endpoint unless the table description specifies exact binomial inference.
## Column 5 | Upper 95% bound | Source-reported percentile interval endpoint unless the table description specifies exact binomial inference.
## Column 6 | Pairwise accuracy | Pairwise accuracy for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 7 | Mean rank | Mean rank for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 8 | Mean reciprocal rank | Mean reciprocal rank for the observation defined in the table description.
